mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_change_log (product_name, code_number, stock_system, old_price, new_price, change_date, changed_by) VALUES (#{l.productName}, #{l.codeNumber}, #{l.stockSystem}, #{l.oldPrice}, #{l.newPrice}, #{l.changeDate}, #{l.changedBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT l.product_name AS productName, l.change_date AS changeDate, l.new_price AS newPrice FROM price_change_log l JOIN (SELECT product_name, MAX(id) AS mid FROM price_change_log
WHERE stock_system = #{system} OR stock_system IS NULL
GROUP BY product_name) t ON l.id = t.mid
